stories.title: Chainalysis Confirms Intrusion Into Internal Tools and Exposure of Customer Identity Data
stories.description: Chainalysis confirms an attack using agentic techniques exposed customer names, emails, and user IDs, but not credentials or session tokens.

stories.title: Syrian Hacker Gets Prison Time in US After Over a Decade on the Run
stories.description: A US court sentenced Syrian hacker Ahmad Umar Agha to 42 months for pro-Assad attacks on media, businesses, and government entities.

stories.title: Wireshark 5.0.0rc1 Release, (Sat, Oct 31st)
stories.description: Wireshark Release Candidate 5.0.0 was published: soon we can expect a new major version of Wireshark.

stories.title: Cursor Confirms Malicious Claude Code Extension With SSH Backdoor Was Available for 11 Hours
stories.description: Cursor has confirmed that malicious Claude Code extension packages were available through its VS Code Extension Marketplace for roughly 11 hours on October 29, 2026.

stories.title: Attackers Chain Three Ivanti Connect Secure Flaws to Gain Unauthenticated Root Access
stories.description: CISA adds two exploited Ivanti Connect Secure flaws to its KEV catalog after attackers chained them to gain unauthenticated root-level code execution.

stories.title: Over 60,000 Attacks Target WordPress RCE Vulnerability Within 24 Hours
stories.description: Hackers are targeting a WordPress Core remote code execution vulnerability that can expose websites during software updates. The supplied Wordfence threat intelligence snapshot lists 60,471 blocked attempts over 24 hours.

stories.title: A Shared ChatGPT Link Could Run Attacker Code in Your Session and Read Private Chats
stories.description: OpenAI fixed a P1 ChatGPT flaw that let malicious shared links execute code in signed-in sessions and access private conversations.

stories.title: Cloudflare Reports 18.2 Million Network-Layer DDoS Attacks in Q3, Up 38%
stories.description: Cloudflare mitigated 18.2 million network-layer DDoS attacks in Q3 2026, with short-burst attacks rising 208% and DNS amplification up 215%.

stories.title: Google Launches Gemini 4 Carbon With State-Of-The-Art Cybersecurity Capabilities
stories.description: Google unveiled Gemini 4 Carbon, an AI model based on Gemini 4 Argon that identifies software vulnerabilities, tests exploits, and develops fixes for complex security tasks.

stories.title: TeamViewer Security Flaw Could Turn Remote Support Sessions Into Computer Takeovers
stories.description: A newly disclosed TeamViewer vulnerability could let an attacker turn a routine remote support session against the technician providing help.

stories.title: PHP2Shell Attacks Root Palo Alto Firewalls but Fail Against WordPress
stories.description: Over 22.6 million exposed instances are potentially affected by the critical PHP flaws that have been targeted for over a week.

stories.title: Passkeys Are Better Than Passwords. But They Are Not Enough.
stories.description: As organizations eliminate passwords, attackers will adapt. Instead of attacking the authenticator directly, they will look for opportunities around it.
